description: This Java source file defines a class URL that extends JLabel and implements MouseListener to display a clickable URL link with custom rendering and handle mouse click events to open the URL in a browser.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A JLabel subclass that displays a URL as clickable text, drawing a line beneath the text and opening the URL in a browser upon click.

methods.name: URL
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the URL label with the provided URL string and sets font and mouse listener.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Overrides the paint method to draw an underline beneath the URL text.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Handles mouse click events by invoking BrowserControl to display the URL.
